account_context.evidence: Rates transcribed from user-provided IMG_0450.PNG; user explicitly confirmed 5 CNY minimum per stock commission charge on 2026-09-13. Screenshot date is unknown. Capital remains an inherited research assumption.

cost_is_per_ticket_not_per_notional.statement: Commission depends on both traded notional and the number of commission charge units because each charge has a confirmed 5 CNY minimum.
cost_is_per_ticket_not_per_notional.design_implication: Evaluate holding count, diversification and fragmented rebalancing jointly. The minimum fee alone does not determine an optimal holding count or mandate whole-position replacement.
cost_is_per_ticket_not_per_notional.charge_aggregation_policy: unverified_order_vs_execution_vs_daily_aggregation; do not apply a separate minimum to each partial fill without broker evidence

commission.all_in_note: Not established by the visible screenshot. It contains an additional taxes/fees section whose details are cut off. Do not assume either inclusive commission or additive handling/regulatory fees without reconciliation.

evidence.minimum_scope_verified: sh_sz_equity; verify other instrument schedules before activation

commission.rounding_policy: unverified; keep calculation precision and reconcile currency rounding against broker statement

implicit_costs.rationale: A-share tick size is a fixed 0.01 CNY, so quoted spread in basis points is a function of price, not of liquidity. At 200k capital a ticket is roughly 10-20k CNY, negligible against any liquid name's depth, so impact is second order.

impact.rationale: Reinstate a participation-rate impact term only when ticket size becomes a material fraction of daily volume. Modelling impact now adds a free parameter with no data to calibrate it.

queue_and_fill_risk.rationale: Marketable-limit execution at the next unified trading day is assumed. Partial-fill and adverse-selection costs remain an unmodelled residual.

turnover_convention.ticket_count: number of assets whose weight change implies a trade of at least one board lot
turnover_convention.restatement_required: Recompute from actual executed trades; declare cash treatment and use drifted pretrade holdings for turnover. Historical smoke is superseded.

position_count_cost_table.note: Round-trip explicit cost in basis points, 深圳A股 (no transfer fee), excluding half spread.
position_count_cost_table.tension: Lower per-ticket commission can conflict with diversification, but no optimal holding count has been established.

bse.reason: 13.75 bps per side is 7.4x the 沪深 rate; round-trip explicit cost reaches roughly 32.6 bps before spread.

neeq.reason: 15.0 bps per side plus materially worse liquidity.

preregistered_t4_grid.selection_rule: highest net information ratio under this cost model
preregistered_t4_grid.rationale: Both N and frequency change cost through the ticket-count channel, so they cannot be selected independently.
preregistered_t4_grid.status: inherited_v1_grid; revise preregistration before selection under v2

forbidden: tuning the spread or impact model after seeing net performance
computing commission without applying the 5 CNY per-ticket floor
excluding an asset class on cost grounds without recording it in universe_cost_exclusions
treating the absence of an impact term as evidence that impact is zero at larger capital

unresolved: minimum fee charge aggregation and currency rounding
applicable minimums for instruments outside sh_sz_equity
